title: Israeli Settlers Beat AFP Photographer as IDF Soldiers Watch in West Bank
detail: Israeli settlers attacked and beat an AFP photographer during West Bank coverage while Israeli soldiers stood by without intervening. The incident drew international condemnation and renewed scrutiny of IDF failure to protect journalists covering settler violence in the occupied West Bank.

title: Far-Right Minister Petitions to Unblock E1 Settlement Tender Near Jerusalem
detail: A far-right Israeli minister filed a petition challenging the Attorney General's freeze on the E1 settlement tender near Jerusalem, intensifying the legal battle over West Bank expansion. The E1 corridor is considered highly sensitive as its development would effectively bisect the West Bank and complicate any future Palestinian state.
